answers.title: Drug resistance mutations and phylogenetic analysis of HIV-1 subtypes B and F from mothers and children with vertical transmission
answers.table1_caption: Main drug resistance–associated mutations and genetic difference detected between pair in HIV-1 sequences isolated from mother–child pairs in Maranhão and Pernambuco (Northeast region of Brazil), 2007–2022. PI, protease inhibitors; NNRTIs, non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors; NRTIs, nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors
answers.figure1_description: Figure 1 is a grouped bar chart with two panels comparing Mother (red/pink bars) and Child (teal/green bars) groups per the 'Group' legend. Panel A shows 'NNRTI Drugs' (DOR, EFV, ETR, NVP, RPV) on the x-axis with y-axis 'Resistance count (N)' scaled 0–10; Panel B shows 'NRTI Drugs' (3TC, ABC, AZT, D4T, DDI, FTC, TDF) on the x-axis with y-axis 'Resistance count (N)' scaled 0–6. Specific visible values: for EFV the mother bar reaches 10 versus 8 for children (NVP is likewise 10 vs 8), and for ABC both mothers and children have a resistance count of 6.
answers.figure1_detail_not_in_caption: The x-axis of panel B labels the zidovudine drug as 'AZT', whereas the caption and article text only use/define the abbreviation 'ZDV' (zidovudine); 'AZT' appears only on the figure axis and is not mentioned in the caption or body text.
